integrity: The characteristic polynomial, Routh-Hurwitz determinants, threshold radical, and boundary factorization are derived exactly from the published vector field and replayed by a dependency-free checker. Numerical eigenvalues are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local spectral classification on the fixed parameter slice \(\sigma=4\), \(\delta=1/2\), \(b=2\). It does not establish a nonlinear Hopf bifurcation, classify global attractors or basins, or exclude an unindexed equivalent prior derivation.
title: Exact local-stability boundary on the principal four-dimensional laser slice
